description: 겁 많지만 용감한 아기 토끼 (a timid but brave baby rabbit)

fixed: Main fur color: Light to medium brown (tan).
Secondary fur color: Lighter cream/off-white on the muzzle, belly, chest, and inside of the legs/paws.
Ear color: Outer ears are light to medium brown, inner ears are light pink.
Eyes: Large, round, solid black with a distinct small white circular highlight in the upper part of each eye.
Nose: Small, light pink, triangular shape.
Mouth: Small black 'X' shape located directly below the nose.
Whiskers: Thin, subtle black lines extending from the sides of the muzzle (approximately 3-4 per side).
Ears: Long, floppy (lop) ears that hang downwards to the sides of the head.
Head Tuft: A small tuft of light brown fur/hair on top of the head, styled slightly forward over the forehead.
Body proportions: Plump, rounded, baby-like body with short limbs.
Typical standing posture: When standing on two feet, the character holds its front paws together in front of its chest/belly.
Art Style: Watercolor illustration style with distinct thin black outlines, soft textures, and a gentle appearance.
forbidden: Any species other than a lop-eared baby rabbit.
Significant changes to fur color (e.g., bright colors, patterns not present in the reference).
Different eye colors (e.g., blue, green), smaller or differently shaped eyes, or absence of white highlights in eyes.
Glasses, monocles, or similar eye accessories.
Different nose shape (e.g., realistic rabbit nose) or color.
Different mouth shape (e.g., open mouth, wide smile, frown, visible teeth).
Facial hair (other than the established whiskers and head tuft).
Outfits, clothing, hats, bows, jewelry, or any other accessories.
Unnatural or radically different body proportions (e.g., skinny, overly muscular, very long legs).
Realistic photo style or drastically different art styles (e.g., CGI, 3D render, highly abstract, comic book style, pixel art).
Aggressive, angry, or overly confident facial expressions that contradict the "timid" aspect of its personality.

style.description: Soft watercolor painting with gentle, thin, dark outlines, a soft and muted natural palette, subtle paper texture and watercolor pigment variations, and sparse washes with significant negative space in the background.
